DISTT. NEEMUCH (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 ( BY SHRI VISHAL PANWAR - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE FOR THE  RESPONDENTS STATE)
 (NONE FOR THE PROSECUTRIX, DESPITE SERVICE OF NOTICE)

This application coming on for order this day, th e cour  following:
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

2. This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.12/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Neemuch (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2) (n), 323, 506/34 of IPC .
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that prior to the incident the prosecutirx and co-accused Vikas had known to each other.
At about four months prior to the incident the co-accused Vikas had committed rape upon the prosecutrix.

On 05.03.2023 the marriage of the prosecutrix was Lala @ Lalu Ram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8224347/
1 solemnized with someone else.

sentences.text: Thereafter on 21.03.2023, co-accused Vikas called her and forcibly married with her in Arya Samaj Mandir.
On 24.03.2023 main accused Vikas alongwith the present applicant went to the house of the prosecutrix at about 09:00 PM and called the prosecutrix.

On which the prosecutrix came over there and then the main accused and the present applicant took her to Neemuch in a motorcycle and kept her in an abandoned house where the main accused again committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
He kept the prosecutirx in an abandoned house from 24.03.2023 to 31.3.2023 and repeatedly committed rape upon her.
On 11.04.2023 an FIR was lodged against the main accused and the present applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated.
At the time of the incident the prosecutrix was a major lady.
The present applicant has not committed rape upon the prosecutrix.

After completion of investigation,
charge-sheet has been filed.
He is in custody since 12.04.2023.
The trial will take sufficient long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that present applicant/accused be released on bail.
5 . On the other hand, learned Government Advocate for the non- applicant/State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and also considering the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the limited role on part of the present applicant coupled with the fact that trial of this case will take sufficient long time, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant- Lala @Lalu Ram shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) alongwith one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for his appearance presence before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
7.
With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE rashmi Lala @ Lalu Ram vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8224347/
